text: Two years ago I called Rockmount Ranch Wear for two shirts for my dad. They never turned up because the rep botched the address, wrote 7 by hand and they read it as a 1. So ours was 5407 but the shirts went to 5401. The folks at 5401 took the box to the UPS store for a return. Just disappeared. Never saw or heard of them again. It was several weeks later before we found out. We ordered another two shirts while the thing was unresolved. Rockmount wouldn't refund the first pair, that was in the midst of our dispute. At that stage the owner came in and handled it himself. He said the shipment went to the wrong address but we wouldn't get refund until they were returned. Said our bad behavior was part of the reason, we weren't friendly to the 5401 folks who were just four doors away. We argued chargeback with credit-card company and eventually got a credit.
